cues.text: In a school hallway, Hidetoshi stands face to face with another student beside a door. You watch from a few steps away, and two girls stop nearby to look on.
The student punches Hidetoshi in the stomach, and he doubles over against the wall.
The student walks off past you, the two girls move on, and Hidetoshi straightens up and folds his arms as you go up to him.
